versions.content: Handling if attempts to add a reception secure association at an Ethernet switch port and to enable or disable this secure association has been finalized Status: DRAFT If EthSwt_MacSecAddRxSa was called for an EthSwtPort with EthSwtPortMac- SecEnabled set to TRUE and the attempts to add a reception secure association and to enable or disable this reception secure association for the corresponding Ether- net switch port has been successfully finalized, then the EthSwt driver shall notify the EthIf by calling EthIf_SwitchMacSecAddRxSaNotification with Result set to E_OK . Otherwise the EthSwt driver shall call EthIf_SwitchMacSecAddRxSaNoti- fication with Result set to E_NOT_OK .
